components.name: primary-button
components.role: Primary action button for the most important local action.

components.name: secondary-button
components.role: Secondary action button with lower emphasis than the primary action.

components.name: icon-button
components.role: Icon-only action with explicit accessible name and stable hit target.

components.name: text-field
components.role: Single-line text input with label, helper, error, disabled, and readonly states.

components.name: select
components.role: Single-value option selector for bounded choices.

components.name: checkbox
components.role: Boolean or multi-select input with checked, unchecked, mixed, and disabled states.

components.name: switch
components.role: Immediate on/off preference control.

components.name: segmented-control
components.role: Small mutually exclusive mode switcher.

components.name: breadcrumbs
components.role: Hierarchy trail for deep product areas.

components.name: tabs
components.role: Peer view switcher for related panels.

components.name: pagination
components.role: Paged data navigation for tables and long lists.

components.name: badge
components.role: Compact status, category, or count label.

components.name: inline-alert
components.role: Inline message for contextual info, success, warning, and error states.

components.name: empty-state
components.role: Actionable empty or zero-result state.

components.name: toast
components.role: Temporary non-blocking feedback after a completed action.

components.name: status-dot
components.role: Small operational status indicator paired with visible text.

components.name: dialog
components.role: Modal decision or focused task surface.

components.name: popover
components.role: Anchored transient surface for short forms or contextual controls.

components.name: tooltip
components.role: Short accessible explanation for icon-only or compact controls.

components.name: inspector-drawer
components.role: Contextual detail drawer for properties, policy facts, or record metadata
usage_guidance: a selected item needs rich detail without leaving the main workflow
users need source facts, owners, versions, or retention metadata
avoid_when: the detail is short enough for an inline disclosure

components.name: resizable-split-pane
components.role: Resizable two/three-pane workspace shell for dense tools
usage_guidance: primary work happens between list, canvas/chat, and detail panels
users need to compare or inspect adjacent information without navigation
avoid_when: single linear form or landing page is enough

components.name: command-palette
components.role: Keyboard-first command launcher and cross-surface search
usage_guidance: the product has many actions or navigation targets
expert users benefit from quick action search
avoid_when: there are fewer than five meaningful commands

components.name: confidence-meter
components.role: Confidence or certainty meter with explanation and threshold labels
usage_guidance: AI or policy outcome includes uncertainty
users must decide whether to trust, edit, or escalate
avoid_when: confidence cannot be explained or calibrated

components.name: evidence-graph
components.role: Node-link evidence map connecting claims, sources, policies, and decisions
usage_guidance: trust depends on seeing relationships between claims and sources
auditors need to trace why an answer or decision was made
avoid_when: a simple source list communicates the relationship

components.name: filter-builder
components.role: Advanced condition builder for multi-field filtering
usage_guidance: users need AND/OR logic across several fields
filters should be saved, shared, or audited
avoid_when: a few filter chips are sufficient

components.name: saved-view-bar
components.role: Saved view and scope switcher for repeated operational filters
usage_guidance: teams revisit the same filtered views often
dense tools need stable scope memory
avoid_when: filters are one-off and simple

components.name: bulk-action-table
components.role: Selectable data table with sticky bulk action affordances
usage_guidance: users handle many records at once
selection count and destructive actions must stay visible
avoid_when: records are read-only or single-action

components.name: citation-drawer
components.role: Source and citation drawer for AI answers, policies, and quoted evidence
usage_guidance: answers must show supporting policy, document, or source records
users need to inspect evidence without losing conversation context
avoid_when: citations are static footnotes only

components.name: exception-queue
components.role: Work queue for unresolved policy, data, or workflow exceptions
usage_guidance: multiple issues require triage, assignment, and resolution
reviewers need to batch handle exceptions
avoid_when: exceptions are rare and single-item

components.name: risk-summary-card
components.role: Compact risk score card with drivers, confidence, and recommended mitigation
usage_guidance: users need a fast read of risk before drilling into policy details
AI confidence or compliance severity must be visible
avoid_when: score cannot be explained with drivers

components.name: source-card
components.role: Compact source record card with title, excerpt, metadata, and verification state
usage_guidance: AI output depends on external or internal source records
users need a repeatable citation preview component
avoid_when: source metadata is unavailable

provenance.detail: Archetype candidate inferred from query and brand context only; local image grounding was unavailable.

systems.name: Astryx
systems.role: broad React component taxonomy, templates, themes, and agent-ready docs
use_for: agent documentation and CLI workflow patterns

systems.name: Vercel Geist
systems.role: compact developer-tool UI baseline with precise, minimal interaction patterns
use_for: accessibility and async state coverage labels

denied: implementation source code unless the project license and target use allow it
absorption_policy.rule: Use Astryx and Geist as taxonomy and behavior evidence; implement with local primitives and local tokens.

link-button.reason: content/link primitive, not an action baseline
